summary: On the main deck, surrounded by destruction raining down around her, Trinity takes hold of Neo's body and speaks his name, addressing him as 'Neo...' amid the chaos.

what_changes.before: Standing amid the destruction raining around her, apart from Neo's body
what_changes.after: She physically takes hold of Neo's body and addresses him by name
what_changes.evidence: Amid the destruction raining around her, Trinity takes hold of Neo's body.

event_hint.one_line: Trinity holds Neo's body and speaks his name amid the destruction on the main deck.
